card.name: Editing credits before a name
card.fires_on: The words editing, editor, reviewer, proof-read and the word by or and that follow them, in credit lines at the end of news or web articles. It responds just before the editor's name is given.

modes.label: Editing by credit
modes.description: The word editing or the word by after it in a news wire credit line.
modes.example: (Reporting By Erik Kirschbaum;<< editing>> by Stephen Brown and Anthony Barker)

modes.label: Editor or reviewer role
modes.description: A role word such as editor, reviewer or checker that is followed by a person's name.

card.plain: It fires in the small credit line that says who edited, proofread or reviewed a piece, right before the person's name.
